author: Kairos II
title: VEN v3c: Dynamic c-grid + schema aliases (threshold_frac, ridge_points, max_ven)
abstract: Fix v3 by parsing ven_threshold_sweep.csv using aliases (threshold_frac, ridge_points, max_ven), building a c-grid from observed thresholds, and optionally importing tail_mass from tail_sensitivity files. Compute Gaussian-weighted left/right slopes and flip differentials; write per-dist metrics and summary.
